key_fields.name: DIS-GROUP-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 50-byte disclosure group record (comment RECLN 50; field sizes add up to 50).

key_fields.name: DIS-GROUP-KEY
key_fields.meaning: Composite key: account group id + transaction type code + category code. CBACT04C falls back to group id 'DEFAULT' when the account's group is not found.

key_fields.name: DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
key_fields.meaning: 10-byte account group id, matching ACCT-GROUP-ID in CVACT01Y.

key_fields.name: DIS-INT-RATE
key_fields.meaning: Signed interest rate S9(04)V99. CBACT04C divides balance x rate by 1200, which implies an annual percentage rate (Inferred from the formula).

purpose: CVTRA02Y defines DIS-GROUP-RECORD, the 50-byte disclosure group (interest rate) table keyed by account group, transaction type and transaction category. Its only user in the repository is CBACT04C, which looks up DIS-INT-RATE for each transaction category balance and skips interest when the rate is zero.
